_doc: A flanged nut for a T8 lead screw, the unbranded hobby part in brass: community until measured, from the Handson Technology drawing of the common round-flange Tr8x8(P2) nut. Every listing for the POM nut found gives its thread and lead but no drawing of its body: a POM nut's outline varies from seller to seller, so variant POM-lead-4 changes only material and lead, and its outline must be measured. Axis along z, the flange's mounting face at z = 0.
name: t8-nut

POM-lead-4.source: Rat Rig POM lead screw nut, TR8*4, https://ratrig.com/leadscrew-nut-pom-tr8-4.html
